newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Young Poong '96 zinc output edges up.
newsitem.headline: Young Poong '96 zinc output edges up.

text.p: Zinc production at South Korea's second largest zinc producer Young Poong Corp rose slightly to 90,415 tonnes in 1996, compared to 89,643 tonnes in 1995, an official at the company said on Friday.
Earlier on Friday, Korea Zinc Co Ltd said its zinc production rose 3.2 percent to 196,000 tonnes in 1996 from 190,000 tonnes in the previous year.
Korea Zinc is South Korea's largest zinc and lead producer.
Metal traders in Seoul said South Korea's total zinc production was estimated at 286,415 tonnes in 1996, compared to 279,643 tonnes in the previous year.
Last year, South Korea's zinc imports totalled 89,364 tonnes.

China supplied 28,363 tonnes of the nation's imports in 1996, followed by Russia, 21,967 tonnes, Australia, 12,326 tonnes and Peru, 11,702 tonnes. They did not give the comparative figures for the previous year.
